newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc loses ground to dollar, mark at close.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc loses ground to dollar, mark at close.

text.p: 1550 GMT - The Swiss franc ended slightly easier versus both the dollar and mark, but held within recent ranges.

Traders said dollar/mark was the main factor driving dollar/Swiss. The dollar gained against the mark after Bundesbank council member Hans-Juergen Krupp said that the German economy was in a grave state, and monetary policy cannot ignore this. "Comments from Bundesbankers like Krupp today support the case for lower rates in Germany," Credit Suisse said in a market commentary.
"Basically the same story is still on. Interest rate differentials strongly favour a higher dollar," CS wrote.
The Swiss National Bank left rates unchanged, with the discount still at 1.00 percent, on Thursday.
A UBS analyst said mark/Swiss had done little on Thursday. He noted while the dollar had strengthened against the mark, it was still having trouble getting above 1.60 marks.
*The dollar ended higher at 1.3761/3767 Swiss francs vs 1.3728/3734 at Wednesday's close.
*The mark ended higher at 86.29/32 centimes vs 86.17/19.
